alternative_stack.name: Stack C+HE21 — RT Spike Capture
alternative_stack.trigger: Real-time wind underperform HE19-21 >= 500 MW below forecast OR Tenaska operations confirms high-probability RT dispatch event OR SOUTH_HOUSTON_IMPORT non-binding floor crossed per real-time data
alternative_stack.change_from_primary: Reduce HE19 discharge from 70 MW to 50 MW; add HE21 +20 MW RT offer at threshold >=80/MWh RT
alternative_stack.expected_delta_vs_primary_base_note: Base case: lost HE19 $1,760 + gained HE21 RT EV $800 (20 MW x $200 x 20% P(spike)) = -$960 vs primary
alternative_stack.breakeven_note: At P(HE21 RT > $200/MWh) >= 35%, Alternative Stack has equal or higher EV than Primary. SOUTH_HOUSTON_IMPORT binding (P15-25%) may push P(spike) to this level.
alternative_stack.activate_if: SOUTH_HOUSTON_IMPORT ramp crosses non-binding floor in real-time (observed NL ramp >= 15,000 MW) OR wind HE19-21 < 500 MW below COPHSL forecast

operational_notes.da_charge_execution_risk: 7+ consecutive cycle failures at HE09-12 (Aug 27-Sep 2). Primary window HE03-04 confirmed per Sep 3 learnings. HE10-11 excluded from primary — contingency only.
operational_notes.he10_11_da_charge_contingency: File backup DA bids HE10 <=15/MWh, HE11 <=18/MWh ONLY if HE03-04 fails at 10:30 CT check. Not primary.
operational_notes.rt_opportunistic_charge_he10_12: If HE10-12 RT <= 0/MWh real-time, charge up to 17 MW for 1 hour (max SoC headroom = 200 - 184.4 = 15.6 MWh / 0.922 = 16.9 MW). Not a DA bid — operational decision only.
operational_notes.as_energy_overlap_rule: ZERO AS MW in HE03, HE04, HE19, HE20 — absolute hard constraint. Block submission if violated.
operational_notes.ecrs_supplementary: 30 MW ECRS DA at HE14-18 is a supplementary option. If offered: reduce NonSpin from 85 MW to 55 MW in those hours; total capacity stays 85 MW. Only file if ops confirms ECRS clearing.
operational_notes.da_bid_floors_hard: HE19 floor >=65/MWh (do not lower); HE20 floor >=100/MWh (do not lower). Below these levels, energy arbitrage economics break vs round-trip cost.
operational_notes.bid_cutoff: DAM bids due 10:00 CT — submit by 09:30 CT for 30-min buffer
operational_notes.post_dam_check_1030ct: If HE03-04 DA charge did not clear by 10:30 CT, activate contingency HE10-11 bids and evaluate RT-only mode
